description: Start bringing the chosen records into the catalog, within the plan's room. Covers come in only when the artist said they are theirs to use (rights_confirmed: true, their own words, recorded as their consent); otherwise every record comes in with its codes and the cover is left to upload.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and it happens once.

rights_confirmed.description: Only true when the artist said the covers are theirs to use.

name: import_catalog
title: Bring the records in
